blocks.caption: Common Wings: more elytra than bird

blocks.text: Every legend starts somewhere, and mine started with two grey wings and a bruised knee. Yours will start the same way: with the Common Wings, the only common pair.

blocks.caption: Leather, an elytra and two feathers

blocks.text: They are joined at the Assembly Table: leather as the harness, an elytra (enchanted or not) as the core, and one feather for each wing. No essence is needed.

The table stands in the Sky Sanctum, which rises far out in the End when the Ender Dragon dies for the second time. Take an elytra from an End City: it carries you to the sanctum, then becomes the heart of your wings.
Until the third dragon falls, the Common Wings are the only pair the table can assemble. Every other pair needs pieces from the Forge Bench.
Right-click the Common Wings. The item vanishes, the pair joins your collection and is equipped. From now on, the wing button sits under your inventory and the J key opens the Wings menu.
Jump as usual, then press jump again while in the air: your wings beat once and lift you. This wing jump costs 20 stamina, and you may chain as many as your stamina allows.
The Common Wings hold about 100 stamina, so five wing jumps in a row. When too little is left for another, two free rescue jumps remain to break your fall. Both come back when you touch the ground.
Then try the rest: tap jump twice, very fast, to hover in place; press Left Alt in the air to switch into travel flight. Modest wings, modest flight, but flight all the same.
